_purpose: NS-token grouping for TAAC 2026 PCVR prediction (HyFormer v0.2).
_format: Top-level keys: 'user_ns_groups' and 'item_ns_groups'. Each maps a group name to a list of feature ids (fids). Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_usage: Used only by --ns_tokenizer_type group. The active RankMixer config (--ns_tokenizer_type rankmixer) ignores this file and auto-splits all feature embeddings into tunable token counts.
_note_T: With d_model=128, num_ns=12 (7 user + 1 user_dense + 4 item), num_queries=1: T = 1*4 + 12 = 16, d_model%T == 0.
_comment_item_groups: Item groups optimized for ad/conversion features: I1=ad identity, I2=ad content/creative, I3=advertiser context, I4=placement context.
